purpose: Bottom navigation of a mobile app: three to five top-level destinations, always visible, each one changing the page. Reach for it as the main navigation on phone layouts.

notFor.case: Switching views or filters inside one page.
Navigation on desktop or laptop layouts.
More than five destinations, or secondary destinations.
A single choice between short options of the same data.

Default.visual: A full-width bar on Surface/page with a Border/subtle hairline on top; the items share the width equally.

a11y.keyboard: Natural Tab order through the item links; Enter follows a link. No roving tabindex and no arrow keys: it is not a tablist.
notes: A nav landmark named by aria-label (for example "Main") wrapping a list of links.
Each item is at least Size/target-min tall, which is 44 on the Tablet and Mobile viewports where the bar lives.

openQuestions: Three to five items and exactly one Current: should the component enforce this, or is it guidance only?
